column3: The Hebrew names counsel without an explicit My; BSB adds My.
The Hebrew explicitly says to gird his loins; BSB says brace yourself.
The Hebrew calls them sons of God and says they shouted; BSB adds for joy to the shouting.
The Hebrew names a swaddling band; BSB says blanket.
The Hebrew names My boundary and a singular bar; BSB has its boundaries and bars.
The Hebrew says to seize the earth’s wings or corners and has the wicked passively shaken from it; BSB describes dawn spreading to the ends and actively shaking them out.
The Hebrew does not separately name hills or folds; BSB supplies both in describing the garment image.
The Hebrew describes walking in exploration of the deep; BSB identifies trenches of the deep.
The Hebrew asks where darkness has its place without a separate do you know; BSB supplies that question.
The Hebrew names light; BSB identifies lightning.
The Hebrew describes land without a person; BSB calls it barren land.
The Hebrew connects the questions with or; BSB gives separate questions.
The Hebrew describes waters hiding and the deep’s surface joining together; BSB says becoming hard and frozen.
